|game_text=Deploy on table. At the same site as Jabba’s Prize opponent’s deploy cost is +1 and your Force drains are +2 (may not be canceled or modified by opponent). Opponent may not move during your turn while you have a frozen captive. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The initial surviving text protects your boosted Force drain against the opponent and forbids opposing movement throughout your turn while a captive is frozen. The earlier issuer gallery face keeps the full-turn timing and omits the protection. The dated 14 September 2007 replacement limits the prohibition to your battle phase. The earlier face’s 27 November capture dates the surviving copy. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071127053339id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v6/ds/despair.gif Earlier issuer composite, capture of 27 November 2007]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf#page=1 Cover dates the 14 September 2007 replacement]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf#page=2 February 2004 corroboration of the earliest wording]. This article displays its matching 2004 slip. The previously associated images represent another edition or card.
